subject: MAP: Benchmarking execution plan, access logistics, and close timeline (DataForge POC)
messages:
From: Oliver Jenkins <oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@dataforge.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP + perf plan for POC (DataForge)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. DataForge is ready to run a short performance validation as the final gate before procurement. We want the MAP to include: target TTFT (time-to-first-token) SLA, steady-state throughput at 99% availability, and concurrency targets for our typical burst profile (50-200 concurrent sessions).

Can you confirm:
- What test environment/access you need from us (IP allowlist, test accounts, keys)?
- Typical load window durations you recommend (30m/1h/4h)?
- Any client-side load script options you prefer (JMeter, locust, custom SDK)?

We want results captured in the MAP so execs can sign off quickly. Procurement would like a proposed close timeline if performance is within thresholds.

Oliver Jenkins
Head of Platform Ops, DataForge
oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Jenkins <oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + perf plan for POC (DataForge)

Oliver — thanks, this is exactly the right checklist. Draft MAP attached (dataforge_map_v3.xlsx). High-level answers inline: 

- Test environment: We'll run benchmarks against a dedicated demo pool that mirrors your target tier. For IP allowlist please add the following egress ranges and a short-lived test key we will provision: 44.33.120.0/24, 44.33.121.0/24.
- Test accounts/keys: Lauren will generate three keys tied to the Demo-SRD project (valid for 7 days). Keys will be labeled: DF-POC-LOAD-01, DF-POC-LOAD-02, DF-POC-OBS-01.
- Load windows: Recommend two short ramps (30m) plus a 2h sustained window. Typical schedule we propose: 2026-12-10 (ramp + 30m), 2026-12-12 (2h sustained), with optional 2026-12-15 (backup).
- Client tooling: we use a small locust harness that emits token-level traces and supports KV caching to mirror real chat behavior. We'll share the harness and docker image link in the MAP.

Next steps: Lauren will share the keys and the final load windows. If the 12/12 sustained window is green, procurement and our AE can trigger a targeted close the following week.

Vivek
VP, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Jenkins <oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + perf plan for POC (DataForge)

Oliver — attaching the finalized short MAP and the access checklist (see dataforge_map_v3.xlsx in the thread). Key operational items below and the test keys (masked) are already provisioned in the demo project:

- Test keys (masked):
  - DF-POC-LOAD-01: redwood-test-PL-***-01
  - DF-POC-LOAD-02: redwood-test-PL-***-02
  - DF-POC-OBS-01: redwood-test-OBS-***-01

- Allowlist (please add): 44.33.120.0/24, 44.33.121.0/24
- Load windows confirmed: 2026-12-10 14:00-16:30 PST (ramp + 30m smoke), 2026-12-12 09:00-11:00 PST (2h sustained), fallback 2026-12-15 09:00-11:00 PST
- Client harness: locust image hosted at ghcr.io/redwood/df-poc-harness:stable. It replays mixed chat + embedding workloads and supports per-session KV caching.

Observability notes: We will capture token-level latency (TTFT), per-request latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, error rate, and concurrency metrics. We'll also capture KV cache hit-rate for realistic savings. Please confirm that the 12/12 09:00 window is acceptable for your team to standby.

Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Jenkins <oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + perf plan for POC (DataForge) — load window results attached

Oliver / Team — we ran the canonical MAP scenarios during the 2026-12-12 09:00-11:00 PST window. Results attached (load_results_20261212.csv). Summary below (all numbers measured from our demo pool against the DF-POC keys):

Summary (sustained 2h window):
- Workload mix: 70% chat (avg 180 tokens/request), 30% embeddings
- Peak concurrent sessions observed: 210 (burst trimmed to avoid upstream quota)
- TTFT (time-to-first-token): p50 = 70ms, p95 = 190ms, p99 = 420ms
- Per-request latency (generation end): p50 = 420ms, p95 = 1.2s, p99 = 2.8s
- Steady-state throughput: 1,200 tokens/sec sustained (measured average over 30m slices)
- Error rate: 0.6% (mostly transient 502s during a short infra restart at 10:16 PST; see screenshot-error-502.png)
- KV cache hit-rate: 46% (promising for your repeat prefix patterns)

Notes & actions:
- The transient 502 spike correlates with a brief maintenance event in one region; cluster autoscale picked up within ~70s. We recommend re-running the 30m smoke window on 12/15 to validate the fix.
- Observed TTFT and p95 latency meet the thresholds you shared in the MAP (TTFT p95 <= 250ms, per-request p95 <= 1.5s). Steady throughput meets the target for your medium concurrency tier.

Attached: load_results_20261212.csv and screenshot-error-502.png.

Monica Patel
Perf Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Oliver Jenkins <oliver.jenkins@dataforge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Benchmarking execution plan, access logistics, and close timeline (DataForge POC)

Team — great work and congrats on the green run. Quick commercial next steps to align MAP -> close: 

1) Procurement: Oliver, if procurement is comfortable, we can issue a draft quote + a 60-day trial amendment to the Demo contract. Procurement email (from thread): procurement@dataforge.com.
2) DocuSign: I've attached a draft MSA/POA and will push a DocuSign link once you confirm the procurement contact.
3) Validation rerun: Monica proposed a short smoke rerun on 2026-12-15 (we completed the main run but recommend smoke to confirm the transient 502 fix). If that passes, AE & I will ask for a verbal close by 2026-12-22 and contract signature by 2026-12-29.

Decision points for DataForge:
- Confirm procurement contact and sign-off authority (email + name).
- Confirm whether the 60-day trial with a commit at the end is acceptable.

Links: HubSpot deal DF-4721: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DF-4721
Draft contract (DocuSign will be issued once procurement contact is confirmed).

Thanks — putting this on the close calendar.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
